observations: Multiple white plastic tanks encased in metal cage frames, stacked on pallet-style bases, in an open yard with trucks in background.
This is the standard IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tote design, commonly reused as 'chemical tanks' in Nigeria.
Photos 2 and 3 show close-ups with valves/taps (red and blue) fitted at the base of some units.
Metal cages show surface rust and wear in places; plastic bodies show dirt, staining, and discoloration consistent with prior use.
No brand, manufacturer name, or model number is legible on any tank body or cage.
Ground around the tanks is muddy/wet with debris, suggesting an outdoor scrapyard-type storage, not a controlled warehouse.
Units appear to be a uniform bulk size (visually consistent with common 1000-liter IBC totes) but no capacity markings are readable.

identity.kind: used IBC chemical storage tank (tote with cage)

claims.claim: A chemical tank is a specialized container built to safely store, mix, or transport corrosive [materials]...
claims.evidence: This is generic descriptive text about chemical tanks in general; no photo shows certification, material spec sheet, or test proving this specific unit's safety or corrosion resistance.

risks.risk: Unknown prior chemical content/residue inside tank, which could contaminate future use or indicate hazardous history.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of the interior through the top opening, plus any residue/stain visible inside.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-content/contaminated, requiring full cleaning before reuse

risks.risk: Cracks, stress fractures, or UV degradation in the plastic body not visible at this distance/angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides of the tank body, especially corners and base, in good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unverified structural integrity, i.e. not guaranteed leak-proof

risks.risk: Valve/tap functionality (leaks, stuck, broken thread) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Video clip of valve being opened and closed, showing water or air flow without leakage.

risks.risk: Cage rust may be superficial or may indicate deeper corrosion weakening structural support.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rusted cage joints and welds.

risks.risk: Actual liter capacity not confirmed; size could vary between units in the stack.
risks.proof: Photo of capacity markings/label plate on the tank shoulder or cage data plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest commonly seen size for this tote type absent proof of larger capacity

proof_requests: Photo of the data/capacity plate on the cage or tank shoulder.
Interior photo/video showing residue or cleanliness.
Video of valve operation (open/close, flow test).
Close-up photos of cage welds/joints for rust depth.
Close-up of tank body corners/base for cracks or fractures.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as used IBC chemical storage totes; since none of the seller's safety/quality claims or the tank's condition (interior residue, valve function, structural integrity, capacity) can be verified from the photos, it must be priced at worst case as a used, unverified-condition tote pending the listed proofs.
